raw_segments.text: Some answer must be had to these questions. I could find it nowhere, but at the inn, and thither, ere long, I returned.
The host himself brought my breakfast into the parlor. I requested him to shut the door and sit down.
I had some questions to ask him, but when he complied,
I scarcely knew how to begin. Such horror had I of the possible answers, and yet the spectacle of desolation
I had just left prepared me in a measure for a tale of misery.
The host was a respectable-looking, middle-aged man.
